name: RoleAssign with User CSV Import
description: Makes the User CSV Import form show only the roles a delegated admin may assign, per the RoleAssign module.
project_description:
This module imports user fields from a CSV file and creates a new user account with the information contained in the file. In addition, it lets you select which fields to import.

 Most fields that comes with the Drupal core can be imported, with the exception of "Image" and "Taxonomy term".

 Submodule: RoleAssign With User CSV Import 
 This is a submodule that ships with this project. If you use the module RoleAssign and you need to restrict the roles in the User CSV Import form to match, you may want to enable this.
